description: Build a multi-projector architectural facade rig: one source TOP fanned into N per-projector branches, each with Crop → Corner Pin keystone → edge-blend Ramp/Composite mask → Level brightness, plus per-projector Null outputs and a summary preview composite. Ships as a calibration skeleton; per-projector corners, color match, and (when 3D) camera transforms are left to live install alignment.

blend_curve.description: Curve applied to the alpha gradient via Level gamma.

blend_layout.description: How projectors tile: horizontal row, vertical column, or near-square grid.

blend_width.description: Edge-blend overlap region in pixels (alpha gradient width on inner edges).

expose_controls.description: Build a Control Panel with per-projector brightness + global blend width/curve.

facade_geometry_path.description: Optional absolute SOP/COMP path to a 3D facade model. PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED: when provided, builds a per-projector cameraCOMP + renderTOP + geometryCOMP stub.

name.description: Name of the generated Base COMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP where the facade mapping system is created.

projector_count.description: Number of projectors. Each projector gets its own branch and Null output.

source_mode.description: Synthetic builds a self-animated noiseTOP so the rig previews without an upstream feed.

source_top_path.description: Absolute TOP path to fan out; required when source_mode='existing_top'.

name: create_facade_mapping
